newsitem.title: SPAIN: Release of ETA prisoner sparks Spanish Basque riot.
newsitem.headline: Release of ETA prisoner sparks Spanish Basque riot.

text.p: Celebrations in the Spanish Basque region at the release of an ETA prisoner turned into a riot when hooded gangs spread out attacking a police barracks and a bank, police said on Friday.
There were no arrests or injuries in the incident which started late on Thursday night and the rioters eventually dispersed.

Before the riots started, thousands of people, many from radical separatist groups, had gathered in the northern town of Llodio to greet Jesus Maria Gomez on his release after 14 years imprisonment for ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) activity.
Police said demonstrators paraded through the streets chanting ETA slogans and turned hostile when police arrived.

Some 20 people wearing hoods then started to launch flares at the police barracks, while blockading the access route with cars. ETA has killed some 800 people in the 28 years it has been waging a campaign for Basque independence.
